test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Diesel) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: For separating metals after chain drilling, which of the following types of chisels is used?
solution:
The correct answer is __Web Chisel**(Option 2)**.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Web Chisel__ is specifically designed for separating metals after chain drilling.
 
• This chisel is highly effective for removing waste material between drilled holes.
 
• The shape of the web chisel allows easy cutting and shaping of metal surfaces.
 
• It is commonly used in metalwork and fabrication industries.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Flat Chisel:**

 
 
• This chisel is used for cutting and shaping flat surfaces of metal.
 
• It is not ideal for separating metals after chain drilling.
 
 
 
• **Diamond Pointed Chisel: **
 
 
• It is commonly used for cutting grooves and making fine cuts on metal surfaces.
 
• Not suitable for separating metals after chain drilling.
 
 
 
• **Cross-cut Chisel:**
 
 
• This chisel is used for cutting slots or grooves in metal surfaces.
 
• It does not serve the purpose of separating metals after chain drilling.
